user.title: AmpBridge
user.description: Connect to your AmpBridge server. MQTT port is the broker AmpBridge uses (often 1885). API port is the Phoenix web/API port (often 4000). MQTT base topic must match AmpBridge configuration (default ampbridge/zones).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the AmpBridge API. Check host, API port, HTTPS, and that the server is running.

abort.already_configured: This AmpBridge instance is already configured.
